title: input_schema
description: Schema for input file for automated notice generation.

fields.name: School Name
fields.description: School name with PHIX ID (if available) in format 'SCHOOL NAME - PHIX ID'

fields.name: Overdue Disease
fields.description: Comma-separated list of overdue diseases for client

fields.name: Overdue Agent
fields.description: Comma-separated list of overdue agents for client

fields.name: Imms Given
fields.description: List of immunizations given to client, separated by ';'. Each list entry is in the format 'Mon Day, YYYY - <received vaccine>'. Optionally, each entry may also include validity status of the dose appended as '- <dose validity>'
